en: Black‑and‑white aerial photograph of a small town by a lake. In the foreground are wooden houses, farms, and buildings along dirt roads. Fields and gardens surround the settlement. In the mid‑ground stands a large, prominent church with a tower, located on a wooded peninsula projecting into the lake. The overall style suggests a Nordic rural town. In the lower left corner there is printed text giving the place name and a number.
